items.title: Blocker B-1: StreamDrain.attach committee decision

changes.IR-HTTP-007: AC-4: SPI gains default StreamDrain.attach(OutputStream) (no-op); signature test finds webSocket and attach the only added methods and StreamDrain still @FunctionalInterface; every adapter eventStream calls drain.attach(out) with the same stream later passed to drain(out); second deviation from W2-001 recorded. Rationale note added.
changes.IR-WS-002: AC-5: 'webSocket the only added HttpExchange method and attach(OutputStream) the only added StreamDrain method'; statement amended so it no longer says the WS types are the only SPI additions.
changes.FR-SSE-002: AC-5: handler latch after first send, test reads the first event from the socket before releasing it; write goes to the attached stream under the exchange lock and is flushed. AC-6: 'to the stream attached through StreamDrain.attach(out)'. AC-8 (new, appended): in-memory adapter calls attach with the same instance; adapter that never calls attach falls back to the bounded queue. Rationale note added.
changes.FR-SSE-003: AC-6: eventStream calls drain.attach(out) before returning with the same exchange-synchronized stream; test asserts same instance.
changes.OPS-SSE-001: no change: AC-3 wording ('written straight to the socket') still holds for both shipped adapters
changes.FR-ENGINE-011: no change: no AC mentions the pre-drain path; AC-2 defers to FR-SSE-003

items.title: Hidden cycle FR-WS-010 <-> FR-APP-020
items.decision: FR-APP-020 already depends_on FR-WS-010, so FR-WS-010 -> FR-APP-020 would form a cycle and was rejected. The existing edge is already the acyclic direction; its note was restricted to the T44 ACs (AC-2, AC-6, AC-8, AC-9), and FR-WS-010 records the AC-5 use of FR-APP-020 AC-1 as verification coupling (implement FR-APP-020 AC-1 first, verify both in one group).
